assumptions.claim: The parameter NumAlerts must be >= 1 to produce valid non-empty array ranges for alert_rx_i and alert_tx_o ports.
assumptions.cond: At elaboration time when the module is instantiated.
assumptions.risk: If NumAlerts is 0, the array dimensions [0-1:0] become invalid or zero-width, causing compilation failure or silent truncation, breaking alert connectivity.

uncertain_points.claim: NumAlerts is used to dimension alert ports but not defined in this chunk; if it resolves to 0 or a non-positive integer, the array ranges become invalid.
uncertain_points.cond: When NumAlerts is set to 0 or a value not matching the actual alert count.
uncertain_points.risk: Compile-time error or misrouted alert signals could mask or confuse alert handling in the system.

uncertain_points.claim: Internal signals reg2hw, hw2reg, tl_win_h2d, tl_win_d2h are declared but neither driven nor assigned in this chunk; their drivers and connections reside elsewhere.
uncertain_points.risk: Without proper connection, register interface and windowed bus access may malfunction, but this is expected to be resolved in other regions of the module.
